prose.subject: Pembury Security: New Payout Account & Invoice INV-65036
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to confirm that we have recently updated our vendor payment settings. To streamline our settlement processes, we have added a new payout account: 0x933f13eaaf2fd6897c6ee418768b702dc87a2e3c. This address is now linked directly to our domain, pembury-security.example, for verification purposes.

Please ensure your records are updated to reflect this change for future transactions. Attached you will find invoice INV-65036 for 926.02 USDC, covering the services rendered last month. The invoice aligns with our agreed terms and should be processed by the standard due date.

If you have any questions regarding the new account details or the attached invoice, please let me know. We appreciate your continued partnership and prompt attention to this update.

Best regards,

Jonah Adeyemi
Accounts Manager
Pembury Security
